scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w shared && npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.verify: npm run qa:static && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.check:json: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for(const f of ['config/game.json','config/teams.json','config/players.json']) JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')); console.log('JSON OK')"
